verdict.rationale: Elicit ships a built-in 'Research Agent' that users delegate tasks to directly in the prompt box — it can search sources, add/extract columns, generate figures, draft slides, and iterate, with adjustable effort levels and reusable 'skills' for repeated task types. Community usage (elicit-comm-1) confirms real delegation works quickly for literature tasks, though other community reports flag accuracy/hallucination issues with agent outputs (elicit-comm-3, elicit-comm-4, elicit-comm-5), which affects quality but not the existence of the delegation capability. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of agentic task completion reliability and more first-party detail on autonomous multi-step task execution beyond single queries.
